name: codex-orchestration
description: Nested Terra orchestration with root-only experience verification.

interface.longDescription: Activate Codex Orchestration in a new or already-open task with Turn Orchestration on, Use Orchestration, or Use Orchestration for this chat. Version 0.8.12 keeps the standard service tier and places classification, implementation dispatch, and supervision beneath one fused GPT-5.6 Terra / Max orchestrator. Root starts only that Terra task and mechanically relays its milestone messages, so it never composes downstream role contracts or exposes workflow narration. The same Terra instance handles read-only work and tweak supervision; build routes add a Sol supervisor inside Terra's subtree, serialize sibling activity so descendant chips remain visually nested, and reactivate idle children for every checkpoint handoff. Experience-dependent acceptance is explicit: ordinary UI work uses code, tests, artifacts, and deployed-revision evidence, while a user-facing interaction, rendered claim, reported visual mismatch, or explicit visual-review request requires one bounded root-only browser check with starting state, action, result, and artifacts returned to the same supervisor. Six specialized companion profiles preserve fixed routes for read-only, small tweak, big tweak, small build, and big build work, with pinned built-in fallbacks for already-open tasks. The orchestrator uses wake-on-update waits and reports progress only at real supervisor milestones. The implementer pauses at quiescent checkpoints, the supervisor inspects without editing, and every correction goes back to the same implementer.
defaultPrompt: Tell me “Turn Orchestration on” for same-chat tweak/build routing with checkpoint supervision.
